verdict.rationale: Dagster's asset checks can verify that a tabular asset adheres to a specified schema, and sensors/declarative automation/schedules can propagate or trigger downstream runs based on such checks, with Dagster+ alerts notifying on critical events — giving engineers a policy-driven way to catch and react to upstream data issues rather than silent failures. missing for 10: explicit documentation of automatic schema-diff/drift detection (vs. manual schema checks), and evidence of configurable blocking/severity policies that halt downstream materialization on schema-check failure.
